Estera

Biography

Estera is the Gipath witch who helped Zak in Cursed Lands. She notices Kir’s resemblance to him and is pursuing a flower associated with the Old Dragon. Her knowledge is again useful, although her complaints about Airy and the theft of the Magic Orb reflect her own irritable view of events. [1, 2]
